# Vimeo

Vimeo is a video platform for hosting, managing, sharing, and interacting with video content and account resources.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/vimeo/.

## Actions

- **Get Category** (read-only): Get one public Vimeo category by slug.
- **Get Channel** (read-only): Get one public Vimeo channel by numeric ID.
- **Get Current User** (read-only): Return the connected Vimeo user's numeric user ID, profile, account tier, capabilities, and resource counts.
- **Get Group** (read-only): Get one public Vimeo group by numeric ID.
- **Get On Demand Genre** (read-only): Get one public Vimeo On Demand genre by ID.
- **Get On Demand Region** (read-only): Get one public Vimeo On Demand catalog region by country code.
- **Get On Demand Season** (read-only): Get one season of a public Vimeo On Demand title.
- **Get On Demand Title** (read-only): Get one public Vimeo On Demand title.
- **Get Tag** (read-only): Get one public Vimeo tag by word.
- **Get User** (read-only): Get one public Vimeo user profile.
- **Get Video** (read-only): Return metadata only for a public Vimeo video whose privacy.view is 'anybody'.
- **List Categories** (read-only): Return one sortable page of Vimeo's public video categories for discovering category slugs.
- **List Category Channels** (read-only): Return one page of public channels assigned to a Vimeo category.
- **List Category Groups** (read-only): Return one page of public groups assigned to a Vimeo category.
- **List Category Videos** (read-only): Return one sortable, filterable page of public videos in a Vimeo category.
- **List Channel Categories** (read-only): List categories assigned to a public Vimeo channel.
- **List Channel Followers** (read-only): Return one page of followers of a public Vimeo channel.
- **List Channel Moderators** (read-only): Return one page of moderators of a public Vimeo channel.
- **List Channel Tags** (read-only): List tags assigned to a public Vimeo channel.
- **List Channel Videos** (read-only): Return one searchable, sortable page of public videos in a Vimeo channel.
- **List Channels** (read-only): Return one searchable, sortable page of Vimeo's public curated channels.
- **List Custom Logos** (read-only): Return one page of custom player logos owned by the connected Vimeo user.
- **List Embed Presets** (read-only): Return one page of embed presets for the connected Vimeo user, or for the Vimeo user selected by optional user_id.
- **List Folders** (read-only): Return one page of folders owned by the connected Vimeo user.
- **List Group Members** (read-only): Return one page of members of a public Vimeo group.
- **List Group Videos** (read-only): Return one page of public videos in a Vimeo group.
- **List Groups** (read-only): Return one page of searchable, sortable public Vimeo groups.
- **List My Videos** (read-only): Return one searchable, sortable page of videos uploaded by the connected Vimeo user, including private videos visible to the grant.
- **List On Demand Genres** (read-only): List Vimeo On Demand catalog genres.
- **List On Demand Posters** (read-only): List one page of poster artwork for a public Vimeo On Demand title and return next_cursor.
- **List On Demand Regions** (read-only): List countries and regions in the public Vimeo On Demand catalog.
- **List On Demand Season Videos** (read-only): List one page of On Demand season video metadata and return next_cursor.
- **List On Demand Seasons** (read-only): List one page of seasons for a public Vimeo On Demand title and return next_cursor.
- **List On Demand Title Genres** (read-only): List genres assigned to a public Vimeo On Demand title.
- **List On Demand Title Videos** (read-only): List one page of On Demand title video metadata and return next_cursor.
- **List On Demand Titles By Genre** (read-only): List one page of public Vimeo On Demand titles in a genre and return next_cursor.
- **List Portfolios** (read-only): Return one page of portfolios for the connected Vimeo user, or for the Vimeo user selected by optional user_id.
- **List Showcases** (read-only): Return one searchable, sortable page of Showcases owned by the connected Vimeo user.
- **List User Feed** (read-only): Return one page of Activity records from a Vimeo user's feed.
- **List User Folders** (read-only): Return one page of folders belonging to a Vimeo user or team owner.
- **List User Followed Categories** (read-only): Return one page of categories followed by a Vimeo user.
- **List User Followed Channels** (read-only): Return one page of channels followed by a Vimeo user.
- **List User Followers** (read-only): Return one page of followers of a Vimeo user.
- **List User Following** (read-only): Return one page of users followed by a Vimeo user.
- **List User Liked Videos** (read-only): Return one page of videos liked by a Vimeo user.
- **List User Pictures** (read-only): Return one page of profile pictures for a Vimeo user.
- **List User Watch Later** (read-only): Return one page of videos in a Vimeo user's Watch Later queue.
- **List Video Categories** (read-only): List categories assigned to a public Vimeo video.
- **List Video Likers** (read-only): Return one page of users who liked a public Vimeo video.
- **Search Users** (read-only): Return one page of public Vimeo user profiles matching a search.
